sections.title: Batch
sections.sql: select code,name,source_name,due_date,status from batches where id=$1

sections.title: Fields to correct
sections.sql: select row_number,field,rule,message from exception_queue where batch=(select code from batches where id=$1)
sections.note: Review internally before sharing. No message has been sent.

sections.title: Validation runs
sections.sql: select actor,accepted_rows,rejected_rows,error_count,created_at from validations where batch_id=$1 order by created_at

sections.title: Excluded source rows
sections.sql: select row_number,exclusion_reason from import_rows where batch_id=$1 and excluded order by row_number
sections.note: Blank approval means this batch has not been accepted.

sections.title: Source identity
sections.sql: select code,source_name,source_hash,status from batches where id=$1

sections.title: File receipt
sections.note: A local export receipt does not prove a destination system has loaded the data.
